react.description: A `button[role="tab"]` inside `Tabs`; with `href` or `component`, a link (`aria-current="page"` when selected).

props.description: The element or component to render, such as a router link (its own props pass through).

props.name: href

props.name: icon

props.description: With an icon and a label: where the icon goes.

react.description: Shares the selected `value` between a `Tabs` and its `TabPanel value="…"`s, and links them (`id`, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby`). Keep the value in state and set it from `Tabs onChange`.

props.description: `Tabs` and the `TabPanel`s that go with it.
props.name: children

props.description: The selected tab's `value`.
props.name: value

react.description: The content of one tab: `role="tabpanel"`, in the tab order (it may hold no focusable content). Hide the others with `hidden`, or give each a `value` inside a `TabContext`.

props.description: With `value`: keep the children rendered while the panel is hidden.
props.name: keepMounted

props.description: In a `TabContext`: the tab this panel belongs to. The panel then links itself to its tab and hides itself while another tab is selected.
props.name: value
